mechanism: Duloxetine is metabolized by CYP1A2 and CYP2D6; norethindrone may inhibit CYP1A2 activity, potentially increasing duloxetine levels, while duloxetine's serotonergic effects may theoretically increase thromboembolism risk in hormonal contraceptive users.
action: Monitor for increased duloxetine side effects (nausea, dizziness, hyponatremia); consider duloxetine dose adjustment if adverse effects emerge; counsel on venous thromboembolism risk awareness.
